messages:
maria: heads-up — thinking about adding a latency-smoothing layer to region-aware routing. goal: reduce oscillation when probes spike. sketch: keep short-term EWMA per region per tier and only switch if smoothed difference > threshold + hysteresis. thoughts? @vikram @ajohnson

ajohnson: love EWMA idea. question: where to compute? edge vs control-plane? computing at edge avoids control-plane roundtrip but we need consistent decisions for sticky sessions.

vikram: prefer control-plane decisions for tenant-level policies (quota + fallback). edge can apply fast local smoothing for per-request, fall back to control-plane when unsure. we should define API contract: edge sends region-probe metrics every Ns, control plane returns "selected_region" + "ttl" + "variant_fallback_list".

kelly: UX note — console needs to show per-tenant selected_region + recent probe stats + why we fell back (cost/latency/variant). also rollout controls: canary weight to prefer variant B only for premium tiers.

infra-bot: note: probe ingestion currently stores at /metrics/region-probes. ingestion rate is ~2k/s, might need batching if every edge sends per-tenant.

maria: here's a draft minimal API response: ```json
{"region":"us-west-2","ttl_s":30,"fallback":[{"region":"us-east-1","reason":"latency","penalty_ms":120}],"policy_version":"v2"}
``` edge applies smoothing and respects ttl. ok?

vikram: add "confidence" float and "probe_sample_ts" timestamp. Also need to version policy changes; we should make rollback-safe.

product-sam: product ask — show 'estimated extra cost' if we route to a premium variant or cross-region egress. console should surface before manual override. maybe per-request cost estimate sample.

ajohnson: operational concern: when region oscillates, cached KV and token-affinity breaks. propose sticky session TTL = max(30s, policy_ttl * 2) while in degraded state.

kelly: +1. We'll need telemetry flags to feed alerting: region_switch_count > X in Y => open pager.

maria: next steps: @vikram to draft API proto, @ajohnson to model EWMA thresholds with real probe traces, @kelly to mock console widget. I'll doc the rollout plan and experiment gating. Ping back here with PR links.

deploy-bot: created ticket INF-4627 for probe batching + storage optimizations.
